plain: Dividing something among states or districts by a set rule, such as House seats.

webster.text: The act of apportioning; a dividing into just proportions or shares; a dividing and assigning to each proprietor his just portion of an undivided right or property.

example.quote: The apportionment, in the first instance, and the progressive extinguishment afterward, would be alike productive of ill-humor and animosity.
